Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses BID SPECIFICATION / ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS Particulars Details Name of Work A/R & M/O Bunds and Drains Engagement of manpower on outsourced basis for attendi ng day-to-day office work in all branches of the Office of th Sub-Work e Chief Engineer (Zone-I & II) and Flood Circle-I office, Irrig ation & Flood Control Department, GNCTD. ₹87,02,491/- (Rupees Eighty-Seven Lakh Two Thousand Fo Bid Value ur Hundred Ninety-One only) Contract Period Twelve (12) months / 365 days 1. Scope of Work The work comprises engagement and deployment of outsourced manpower for attending day-to-day office work in the branches of the Office of the Chief Engin eer (Zone-I & II) and Flood Circle-I office, Irrigation & Flood Control Department, GNCTD, for a period of twelve (12) months. The manpower shall assist in routin

e data entry, digital record handling, clerical work, file management, photocopying, scanning and other allied office activities, under the supervision and directions of the Engineer-in-Charge / officer-in-charge of the concerned bra nch. 1.1 Summary of manpower requirement S. No Monthly de Contract Total man-m Category . ployment months onths Data Entry Operator (DE 1 9 12 108 O) 2 Office Assistant 4 12 48 3 Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) 11 12 132 Total 24 12 288 1.2 Duties and responsibilities A. Data Entry Operators – 09 persons The Service Provider shall deploy nine (09) Data Entry Operators having proficie ncy in Microsoft Office applications, including MS Excel, MS Word and MS Power Point, and knowledge/ability to work on the latest web portals and online platfor ms used for official Government work. Their duties shall include: · Data entry, compilation, updating, processing and maintenance of physical and electronic records, registers, databases and other office information. · Preparation, formatting and updating of reports, statements, returns, prese ntations, spreadsheets and other official documents as required by the conc erned branch. · Uploading, submission, retrieval and downloading of information/documents on various Government portals and online platforms, as authorised by the D epartment. · Scanning, indexing, digitisation, sorting and systematic maintenance of rec ords and electronic files. · Checking data for completeness and legibility, bringing discrepancies to the notice of the concerned official and making corrections as instructed. · Any other allied miscellaneous computer/office work assigned by the Engine er-in-Charge or authorised branch officer from time to time. B. Office Assistants – 04 persons The Service Provider shall deploy four (04) Office Assistants having the requisite educational qualification and skills to perform basic office-related clerical tasks. Their duties shall include: · Maintenance, arrangement, indexing and safe handling of files, registers an d records. · Receipt, movement, delivery and handling of official documents and files be tween branches/offices, as directed by the authorised official. · Assistance in dispatch-related activities, preparation of dak, maintenance of dispatch/receipt records and other routine clerical work.

· Assistance in compilation and upkeep of branch records and in locating/retri eving files and documents. · Any other allied clerical or miscellaneous office assistance assigned by the E ngineer-in-Charge or authorised branch officer. C. Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) – 11 persons The Service Provider shall deploy eleven (11) MTS personnel having the requisit e ability to perform basic office-support tasks. Their duties shall include: · Maintenance, arrangement, shifting and orderly placement of files, records, registers and office material. · Photocopying, scanning, printing, stapling, binding and other routine docum entation support. · Movement and delivery of files, dak, papers and other office material within the premises, as directed. · Assistance to officers and staff in routine office activities, upkeep of record r ooms and other basic support duties. · Any other allied miscellaneous office work assigned by the Engineer-in-Char ge or authorised branch officer. 1.3 General deployment requirements · The Service Provider shall provide the full category-wise manpower specifie d in Clause 1.1 and ensure uninterrupted availability throughout the contract period. · Personnel shall be deployed at the locations/branches communicated by the Engineer-in-Charge. The Department may reallocate personnel between the branches/offices according to operational requirements. · All personnel shall be physically fit, disciplined, courteous, punctual and cap able of performing the assigned duties. Personnel shall report to the designat ed officer and follow office timings, attendance procedures and instructions i ssued by the Department. · The Service Provider shall provide substitutes promptly in case of absence, leave, resignation, unsuitability or removal of any deployed person, so that t he sanctioned strength is maintained. No unauthorised substitute shall be de ployed. · The Department may require replacement of any person whose performanc e, conduct, attendance or suitability is found unsatisfactory. The Service Pro vider shall arrange replacement within the time specified by the Engineer-in- Charge, without additional cost. · No deployed person shall claim any employer-employee relationship, regula risation, absorption or appointment in the Department/GNCTD by virtue of d eployment under this contract. 2. Period of Contract and Commencement The contract shall be for twelve (12) months / 365 days. The commencement d ate shall be the date specified in the GeM contract/work order or a written com mencement instruction issued by the competent authority. Extension, if any, sh all be only with the approval of the competent authority and through the permis sible GeM procedure. No extension shall be presumed or claimed as a matter of right.

3. Qualification and Skill Requirements Category Minimum requirement / skill profile Graduate or above, as contemplated in the estimate rate an Data Entry Oper alysis; proficient in MS Word, MS Excel and MS PowerPoint; ator able to handle Government portals, online applications, dat a entry, compilation and digital records. Matriculate but not Graduate, as contemplated in the estim ate rate analysis; capable of routine clerical work, file/recor Office Assistant d arrangement, document handling and dispatch assistance . Suitable for un-skilled category as contemplated in the esti mate rate analysis; capable of routine office assistance, pho MTS tocopying, scanning, file/record handling and movement of office material. The bidder shall ensure that the personnel deployed meet the applicable statut ory and category-wise requirements. The Department may verify original docu ments and may reject or require replacement of any person not meeting the sta ted requirements. 4. Statutory Labour Law and Other Compliance · The Service Provider shall be solely responsible for engagement, employme nt, payment of wages and all employer obligations in respect of the deployed personnel. No liability on this account shall devolve upon the Department ex cept to the extent expressly required by applicable law. · The Service Provider shall pay not less than the latest applicable minimum wages notified by the Labour Department, GNCTD / competent Government authority for the relevant category and period, together with all statutory be nefits and contributions. Any change in statutory wages or contributions shall be dealt with strictly in accordance with applicable law and the GeM co ntract provisions; the estimate rate shall not be construed as authorising pay ment below the legally applicable rate. · Wages shall be paid directly to the bank accounts of the deployed personnel within the statutory timeline. Cash payment shall not be made where prohibi ted by law. Proof of wage disbursement shall be submitted with the monthly bill. · The Service Provider shall comply with all applicable labour laws, including provisions relating to EPF, ESI, employee compensation, minimum wages, pa yment of wages, bonus, gratuity, leave, working hours, holidays, maternity b enefits, occupational safety and other statutory obligations, as applicable. · Valid EPF and ESI registrations, code numbers and other registrations/licenc es required for the contract shall be maintained throughout the contract peri od. Monthly challans, ECRs, contribution details and proof of deposit for the d eployed personnel shall be submitted along with the bill, wherever applicable .

· The Service Provider shall maintain attendance, wage, leave and other statutory registers/records and produce them for inspection whenever requir ed by the Department or any competent authority. · The Service Provider shall be responsible for claims, disputes, penalties and liabilities arising from its non-compliance with applicable labour or other laws, subject to the provisions of law. · The Service Provider shall not engage child labour and shall ensure that all deployed personnel are legally eligible to work. 5. Attendance, Supervision and Conduct · The Service Provider shall nominate an authorised coordinator/supervisor fo r day-to-day coordination with the Engineer-in-Charge. No separate additiona l manpower category or payment for such coordinator is provided in the esti mate unless specifically included in the GeM price schedule. · Attendance shall be recorded through the system/register prescribed by the Department. The Service Provider shall reconcile attendance with the concer ned branch officer before submission of monthly bills. · Personnel shall observe discipline, confidentiality, security instructions, offic e decorum and all directions issued by the Department. They shall not disclo se, copy, remove or share official records/data except as authorised for offici al duties. · The Service Provider shall ensure that personnel do not access Government portals, credentials or confidential information except to the extent authorise d by the Department. Passwords and access credentials, if issued, shall not b e shared. · Absence, late attendance, leaving duty without permission, misconduct or u nsatisfactory performance may attract proportionate deduction or other acti on in accordance with the GeM contract and applicable rules. 6. Payment and Billing · Payment shall be made monthly, on the basis of actual satisfactory manpow er deployment/attendance and the accepted rates in the GeM contract, subje ct to verification and certification by the Engineer-in-Charge. · The monthly bill shall be supported by category-wise attendance, branch-wi se deployment details, wage payment proof, EPF/ESI contribution proof and s uch other documents as may be required under applicable law and the GeM contract. · The quoted price shall be deemed to include all costs and obligations of the Service Provider, including wages, statutory contributions/benefits, service c harges, administrative overheads, taxes and other applicable components, a s priced in the GeM bid. GST shall be dealt with in accordance with the GeM price schedule and applicable law. · No payment shall be admissible for a person not deployed or for a period of unauthorised absence, except as otherwise provided under the GeM contract or applicable law. Deductions, if any, shall be calculated on the basis of the c ontract and actual verified deployment. · The estimate is based on the Labour Department, GNCTD order referred to i n the estimate, namely F. No. (142)/02/MW/VII/Part file/211-241 dated 15.04. 2025, and an estimated increase provision. The Service Provider shall nevert heless comply with the latest legally applicable wage rates during performan

ce. The bid shall be quoted through the relevant GeM service/price schedule. 7. Service Provider’s General Obligations · The Service Provider shall arrange all recruitment, verification, deployment, supervision, replacement and administration of its personnel at its own cost. · The Service Provider shall ensure that no deployed personnel are assigned duties beyond the scope of office support services or contrary to applicable l aw. · The Service Provider shall indemnify and keep the Department/GNCTD inde mnified against claims and liabilities arising out of acts/omissions of its perso nnel or its breach of statutory obligations, to the extent permissible under la w. · The Service Provider shall immediately report any incident, loss, damage, se curity concern or other matter affecting Department property or records. 8. Penalties, Deductions and Unsatisfactory Pe rformance Deductions/penalties for short deployment, absence, non-payment of wages, no n-submission of statutory records, misconduct, breach of confidentiality or unsa tisfactory service shall be imposed only in accordance with the GeM contract, a pplicable GeM GTC/SLA and the specific penalty provisions configured in the bid . 9. Confidentiality and Security All files, records, data, passwords, documents and information accessed by the deployed personnel shall be treated as confidential Government information. Th e Service Provider and its personnel shall use such information only for authoris ed official work and shall not retain, reproduce, transmit or disclose it to any un authorised person. On completion/termination of the contract, all Departmental documents, data and access devices in the possession of the Service Provider/p ersonnel shall be returned forthwith. 10. Termination and Dispute Resolution The contract may be terminated, suspended or otherwise acted upon in accord ance with the GeM contract, GeM GTC, applicable law and the competent autho rity’s directions. Disputes shall be dealt with under the dispute-resolution provis ions of the GeM contract and applicable law.

11. Eligibility Criteria for Bidders 11.1 Work experience The bidder shall have satisfactorily completed similar work(s) during the last se ven (07) years ending on the last day of the month previous to the month in whi ch bids are invited, meeting any one of the following criteria: · Three similar completed works, each costing not less than 40% of the estim ated cost; OR · Two similar completed works, each costing not less than 50% of the estimat ed cost; OR · One similar completed work costing not less than 80% of the estimated cost . For this bid, the estimated cost is ₹87,02,491/-. Accordingly, the corresponding thresholds are approximately ₹34,80,996/- (40%), ₹43,51,246/- (50%) and ₹69, 61,993/- (80%), respectively. The value of completed works shall be updated at simple interest/escalation of 7% per annum from the date of completion up to t he last day of the month previous to the month in which bids are invited. “Similar work” shall mean providing outsourced manpower / manpowe r supply for office support services, including data entry operators, cle rical/office assistants, multi-tasking staff or comparable administrative support manpower to Government departments, public sector underta kings, statutory bodies or other organisations.

11.2 Financial soundness i. The bidder shall have an average annual financial turnover of at least 30% of the estimated cost during the immediate preceding three consecutive fin ancial years, i.e. FY 2023-24, FY 2024-25 and FY 2025-26, ending on 31.03.2 026. On the estimated cost of ₹87,02,491/-, the minimum average annual tu rnover works out to approximately ₹26,10,747/-. The value of annual turnov er figures shall be brought to current value by enhancing the actual turnover figures at simple rate of 7% per annum. · The bidder should not have incurred losses (i.e. profit after tax should be po sitive) in more than two of the last five consecutive financial years ending 31 .03.2026. · The bidder shall submit a certificate of average annual turnover and profit/l oss after tax, duly certified by a Chartered Accountant with UDIN, supported by audited financial statements / relevant documents as per prescribed Perf orma attached at Annexure-A. · The bidder shall submit either- ii. (a) a Banker’s Certificate from a commercial bank for an amount not less th an 40% of the estimated cost, i.e. approximately ₹34,80,996/-, in the prescri bed format attached at Annexure-B; OR (b) a Net Worth Certificate for the financial year 2025-26 ending on 31.03.20 26 issued by a Chartered Accountant with UDIN for not less than 10% of the estimated cost, i.e. approximately ₹8,70,249/- as per prescribed Performa at tached at Annexure-C. · The bidder shall not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proce edings and shall not be bankrupt. 12. Mandatory Documents to be Uploaded with the Bi d- I. PAN card of the bidder / entity. II. Scanned Copy of Demand Draft/Banker’s Cheque/Fixed Deposit Receipt ( FDR) of a commercial bank against EMD. (In case of exemption of EMD, bi dder has to upload relevant documents such as the relevant MSE docume nts.) III. Valid GST registration certificate. IV. Valid EPF and ESI registration certificates / code details, as applicable. V. Work orders and satisfactory completion certificates / performance certific ates supporting the similar-work experience claimed along with Abstract o f Experience certificates provided (as per Annexure-D). VI. Average annual turnover certificate and profit/loss after tax certificate for the prescribed financial years, along with supporting audited financial stat ements. The certificate to be issued by a certified CA with UDIN as per pr escribed Performa attached at Annexure-A VII. (a) Either Banker’s Certificate in the prescribed format attached at Annex ure-B Or (b) Net Worth Certificate for the financial year 2025-26 ending on 31.03.2 026 with UDIN, as per prescribed Performa attached at Annexure-C.

VIII. Undertaking regarding non-bankruptcy / non-liquidation and non- blacklisting/debarment, in the format at Annexure-E. Documents shall be uploaded within the time and in the manner prescribed in t he GeM bid. The bidder shall ensure that all uploaded documents are legible, va lid and complete. Failure to submit mandatory documents shall render the bid li able for rejection.
